notes: The owner, 2026-08-30: *"the notion that you implemented them as JavaScript modules needs to be corrected."* He is right, and the correction is larger than the request that surfaced it. He had asked for SUnit tests of the System Browser, and the honest answer was that a TestCase cannot test a module — so the plan was going to be a capability wrapper around a foreign implementation. That is a workaround for a boundary in the wrong place. A System Browser browses the image; a System Browser whose own logic lives outside the image is the one part of the system that cannot be opened in itself. MEA
